name: layout-fixer
title: Layout Fixer
description: Fix text typed with the wrong keyboard layout, in place — lnpfh becomes مرحبا, and back again.
author: ramysamy

commands.name: fix-layout
commands.title: Fix Keyboard Layout
commands.description: Convert the selected text — or the whole focused text field — between the Arabic and English keyboard layouts.

preferences.name: layout
preferences.title: Arabic Keyboard Layout
preferences.description: Which Arabic keyboard you type on. The macOS and Windows layouts differ across the entire bottom row, so picking the wrong one produces plausible-looking nonsense.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
